player_prompt.intro:
Am ̣Player {player_id} ṭhenak' Reverse Tic Tac Toe khelāre. Amār chinha '{symbol}'.
Lakṣya ṭhik āṭo re rek' ṭin ṭukure ṭhik rek' (samāntar, usargā, bā ṭirchhā).
Jodi ṭin ṭukure ṭhik rek' kana, amār hār.
Amār ṭukure '[4]' rakam ṭhik rek' cel 4 re ṭhik rek' ṭhan.
Player {player_id} ṭhanak', am '{symbol}' ār amār birōdhī '{opponent_symbol}'.
